newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: ICF Kaiser in $160mln Czech mini-mill deal.
newsitem.headline: ICF Kaiser in $160mln Czech mini-mill deal.

text.p: U.S. based ICF Kaiser International Inc signed on Friday a $160 million contract to provide engineering and construction services to complete a mini-mill project at the Czech steelworks Nova Hut a.s. both signatories said.

The contract is the second phase of a deal which began with an initial $102 million contract signed in March 1996 which provided management of the engineering and construction on the first phase of mill in northeastern Czech Republic.
